name: Ame ni Utau Ballade ~A Rainbow After the Rain~
original_name: 雨に歌う譚詩曲～A rainbow after the rain～
source:
Throughout the game you are presented with various flashbacks of a psychiatrist talking with a girl named Ame. 

At the start of the story the protagonist lives with Chinatsu due to various happenings in his childhood that caused him to become an orphan, and as such mainly sees her as an older sister. The prologue basically starts out with Chinatsu telling the protagonist that 3 of her patients will come live with them for a few weeks as a part of their rehabilitation.

[From [url=https://old.reddit.com/r/visualnovels/comments/7nhmbe/what_are_you_reading_untranslated_edition_jan_1/ds28u8y/]xelivous review[/url]]
translation:
遊戲中會多次穿插精神科醫師與名叫雨的女孩交談的回憶。

故事開始時，主角因童年發生的種種變故而成為孤兒，與千夏共同生活，一直把她當成姊姊。序章裡，千夏告訴主角，有三名病人要來家裡住幾個星期，這也是復健療程的一部分。

[摘自[url=https://old.reddit.com/r/visualnovels/comments/7nhmbe/what_are_you_reading_untranslated_edition_jan_1/ds28u8y/]xelivous的評論[/url]]
